title: Who held the map? Twelve centuries of the world in flags
excerpt: The world map from 800 to 2010, each piece of land filled with the flag of whoever held it. In 1000 no land can honestly be shown with a flag; in 1500, 3.7%; by 2010, 97%.
seo_description: An interactive world map in flags from 800 to 2010: who held each piece of land, its flag at the time, and where no flag can honestly be drawn.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Who held the map?' in black on cream, beside a world map of 1914 in which each area is filled with its holder's flag: the Union Flag across Canada, India and much of Africa, the Russian tricolour across Russia, the Stars and Stripes, Brazil's green and gold. Text: 3.7% of land under a flag in 1500, 97% in 2010.
